slides.title: Modern Extension Binding: CFFI & Cython
slides.prompt: CFFI (C Foreign Function Interface) allows writing C declarations directly in Python. Cython compiles a superset of Python (with static type annotations) into fast C extensions, bypassing Python dynamic execution overhead.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Cython example (file: fast_math.pyx)
# cdef defines static C data types for performance
def calculate_sum(int n):
    cdef int i
    cdef long total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        total += i
    return total
